name: Town Watch
title: Amberford Watch
examine: Leather worn pale at the shoulder where the wall-stone rubs it, and eyes that count strangers out of habit.
lines: Mind the gate as you pass. She stands open most days. The day she doesn't, you'll be glad of her.
The ford called the road here. The road called the Redmasks. After that, the town called for stone.
Captain Aldis keeps the north tower. Anything worth reporting goes to her, not to me.
